messages:
maya: Planning to flip the `feature_x_toggle` to safe-defaults tonight in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Who can own the handshake and smoke checks?
liam: I can take primary for the flip and smoke. Will be on-call tonight.
sophia: I can do the quick post-flip perf/latency smoke (5–10m). Will check dashboards and traces.
karen: I’ll be on rotation for rollback if we see errors. Have the rollback playbook open.
maya: Thanks. Ops-bot, please run preflight: config lint + infra health.
ops-bot: preflight checks starting...
ops-bot: config-lint: OK, deployment-cpu: OK, gpu-pools: OK, routing: OK
liam: Quick checklist for everyone: 1) Set flag to safe-defaults 2) Monitor `response_time_p95` and `error_ratio` 3) Verify canary user traffic (10%) 4) Rollback ready.
sophia: For the canary routing, we’ll use `tenant_group: beta` and `traffic: 10%`. Confirmed on the routing side.
maya: For safe-defaults, confirm we keep `model_variant=fallback-small` and `prefix_cache=false` so cost stays bounded.
jordan: Pinged code review: PR #4821 has the toggle wiring and a small telemetry change. @liam can you merge when green?
liam: On it — giving CI 15m. If CI is green I’ll merge and wait 5m before flipping to give the deploy a chance to propagate.
karen: Rollback steps (quick): 
```
1) set feature_x_toggle = off
2) revert PR #4821 if needed
3) scale down newly created pool (if any)
4) notify infra and postmortem channel
```
sophia: Smoke metrics to watch: `inference_latency.p95`, `token_consumption.rate`, `error_ratio` and `model_memory_pressure`. I’ll post screenshots at +5m and +15m.
maya: If anything spikes, call the rollback and @karen will execute. If it's a minor blip (single region) we can failover to eu-region and keep the toggle.
liam: Timeline: 02:00 merge and deploy, 02:05 wait, 02:10 flip to safe-defaults at 10% canary, 02:20 increase to 50% if stable, 02:40 full lift.
jordan: One question — are we toggling the feature gate only in hosted? Private deploys unaffected?
maya: Yes private and dedicated customers are untouched. This is for hosted API only. Documenting that in the release notes.
liam: CI is green, merging now.
liam: deploy triggered (deploy-bot link) :rocket:
maya: Flipped to canary 10% — ops-bot, mark timestamp. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary flip at 02:10 UTC recorded. Monitoring hooks active.
sophia: +5m screenshot: p95 up 3% (within threshold), error_ratio stable. Posting chart link: https://grafana/redwood/d/featx/smoke
karen: All good from rollback perspective. No infra alarms.
maya: Increase to 50% at 02:22.
liam: 50% now. No anomalies.
jordan: Merged PR is tagged and linked in the release notes.
maya: Full lift started 02:39. Stay ready for 15m.
sophia: +15m: metrics steady. token rate normal.
karen: Closing the loop — rollback not needed. Will file a short post-deploy note in #eng-postmortems with the checklist results.
liam: Thanks team — great coordination. :tada:
